verdict.rationale: Sift's Decisions API ingests the business's actions on users, such as approving orders, blocking for fraud, or cancelling for chargebacks (sift-docs-3, sift-docs-17). The docs also state that Sift 'gets smarter the more data it has' (sift-docs-4), and Review Queues provide the human-review step whose outcomes would be reported back (sift-docs-12, sift-comm-4). However, the evidence only implies that these decisions retrain the model and never shows them updating rules or Workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that decisions and confirmed fraud labels are used as model training feedback, any mechanism for review outcomes to refine Workflow rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the learning loop.
